details: Definition: A process in flowering plants where one male gamete fuses with the egg cell (syngamy) and the second fuses with polar nuclei (triple fusion).
Application / Example: Occurs inside angiosperm ovules forming zygote and endosperm.
evidence_or_examples: Occurs inside angiosperm ovules forming zygote and endosperm.

details: Statement / Formula: DNA replication creates two copies of genetic material along with cellular apparatus prior to cell division.
Variable Definitions / Units: Parent Cell -> 2 Daughter Cells with identical/varied DNA copies.
Model Application: Ensures continuity of species characteristics.
key_terms: Parent Cell -> 2 Daughter Cells with identical/varied DNA copies.
